Definition: Uzza or Uzzah, the name of five Israelites
BiblicalUsage: They set the ark of God upon a new cart and brought it out of the house of Abinadab, Uzzah and Ahio driving the cart. Manasseh was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Uzza's name carries both a warning and a landmark: the man who steadied the ark with his hand died for it, and the garden that kept his name became a king's burial ground, so the story is never allowed to forget what happened on that road.
RelatedEvents: David Brings the Ark to Jerusalem
